propositions: The outbound differ compares in vendor shape (reading raw Jira snapshot keys) while the inbound differ compares in canonical shape (post-mapping), creating an asymmetry that violates ADR 0035 §(d) and blocks epic bbf1 AC3.

The outbound update path must canonicalize the snapshot entry via injected InboundMapper before comparison, then emit the vendor payload via a new OutboundMapper.map_fields_to_remote method at the emission boundary only.

InboundMapper output must include three new canonical keys (assignee_identity, remote_parent_id, reporter_identity) that replace vendor-shaped helpers (_assignee_matches, parent-key reads) in core comparison logic.

The assignee resolver and _assignee_is_account_id sentinel must be re-homed to OutboundMapper.resolve_assignee, parameterized only on canonical assignee_identity shape, preserving the existing payload contract downstream.

The partial-baseline dict passed to map_remote_to_local must map only keys present in the input (no defaults for absent vendor keys), ensuring stored remote payloads remain opaque at rest while enabling per-field arbitration decisions.
outbound_differ.py must contain zero imports from adapters.jira and zero raw Jira snapshot key literals, verified by AST gates and deterministic denylist tests.
